perītus

perītus, perīta, perītum

adjective, with the genitive (or the ablative) · Declension on Wiktionary

experienced in, practised, skilled; expert, skilled (with the genitive)

In this lexicon

  • familiar

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 152; Cic. Off. 1.147: doctōs hominēs vel ūsū perītōs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 311

  • professional

    also used · classical · M-O s.v. expert: (homō) perītus; Cic. Imp. Pomp. 68: bellōrum omnium perītissimus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 311

  • chēmiae perītus: chemical

    modern

  • ūsū perītus: practical

    classical
